sources.title: Is Stretching Effective for Reducing Glenohumeral Internal Rotation Deficit? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Crucial for identifying and addressing GIRD (Glenohumeral Internal Rotation Deficit), a common limitation in overhead populations. Provides specific stretching protocols for internal rotation deficits.

sources.title: Rehabilitation of the overhead athlete's shoulder
sources.notes: Outlines foundational scapular and rotator cuff exercises. Excellent for generating progressive rehab-style exercise interventions.

sources.title: Muscle activity and scapular kinematics in individuals with multidirectional shoulder instability: A systematic review
sources.notes: Reports on the problems around having shoulder instability and how it affects the kinetic chain. Provides a strong rationale for the RAG to recommend exercises that target scapular stability and rotator cuff strength.

sources.title: Effectiveness of joint mobilization techniques on the range of motion of adult patients with primary adhesive shoulder capsulitis: systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.notes: Provides data on manual mobilization for frozen shoulder (adhesive capsulitis). Gives the RAG a strong rationale to recommend manual therapy when ROM is limited and stretching alone is insufficient.
